name: B10-0265/2026 (PPE) – Repression and execution of protesters, dissidents, political prisoners and religious minorities in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the repression and execution of protesters, dissidents, political prisoners and religious minorities in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on Iran. It condemns the Iranian government's crackdown on protesters, dissidents, political prisoners and religious minorities, including Christians, Baha'is, Kurds and Baluchis. It calls for an end to violence against civilians, a halt to all executions, the release of everyone held arbitrarily, and the release of two detained Baha'i community members, Peyvand and Borna Naimi. It also urges European Union governments to impose more targeted sanctions.

- The Parliament asks Iran to stop executions and free all arbitrarily detained people.
- It urges European Union governments to widen sanctions on those responsible for abuses.
- It is an opinion only; no law changes and no action is binding.
